description: Approximate exchange rates to EUR as of June 2026. Used by the currencyconversion autocomplete snippet in the SPARQL editor. To refresh: take a reference source such as the ECB euro reference rates (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/) and store the inverse (currency->EUR, i.e. 1/rate); pegged/exotic currencies not covered by the ECB may need another source. Keep the keys in sync with the currencies returned by the sample query in the snippet.
